contentText:
It’s not a competition, but the race to complete the sticker album can be just as intense!

In #Brazil, collectors from all ages gather to swap stickers, share stories, and chase the dream of a full album. But this year’s edition is bigger, and pricier.From intergenerational bonding to black-market scandals, this sticker hunt is about more than just football—it’s a cultural phenomenon.

How much would you be willing to pay to complete the #WorldCup2026 album? Drop your thoughts below!
